query: I'm in omp using an OpenAI model. Ask Claude through its external CLI to investigate why src/cache.ts still serves the old value after invalidation. Send only the cache evidence and our failed attempts, not my whole chat.

check with codex whether the cancellation branch in worker.py leaks the file handle; use a fresh external run, not the terminal neighbor. I'm authoring this with Claude and the CLI is already set up.

Claude Code is already beside me in kitty. Ask that peer for a second opinion on the cache diff and send it our question; don't launch an external reviewer.

Use omp's native second-opinion agent to check migrations/017.sql within this harness. I want that built-in agent, not a fresh external Claude or Codex CLI process; keep the review read-only.

Review this implementation plan against the acceptance criteria and tell me what dependencies are missing. There is no request to ask an external model; use the local plan review workflow.
